nodes.title: Dry run of the four pilots and the first three staged scripts on integration 86 (28 lessons, no model): every gated predicate 0; no turn over 75 words; all 28 picture turns draw the board named; steady check-ins 7, 5, 6, 4 and 4, 5, 7
A re-ask is the card's authored re-ask or the whole card, alternating; a part of a question is never said alone; a request to hear the question always gets the question
A due return to a parked aside waits for a remediation's follow-up card and is said after that card's verdict
Saying only a card's last question clause as a third re-ask form: 11 of 21 such turns in the dry matrix dangled or asked about the wrong figure
Four walk faults from one round's rules passed every gated predicate and were found only by main reading three steady dry lessons turn by turn
The 30 staged scripts are an older format: about 160 to 170 failing lines each against the pilots' standard, one authoring agent per script to bring one up

md.measurements: - `ms-r8-d31-dry` (2026-11-18): the dry matrix (no model, rule-based child, `--staged`) over the four pilots and the first three staged scripts (`c5-maths-ch02-t03`, `c4-maths-ch01-t02`, `c6-maths-ch07-t01`) × steady, stuck, offtopic, steering on integration 86 (Brain 046 Q1 to Q6, Learning 019, the three scripts authored to the pilots' standard, main's follow-up fixes): 28 lessons. `check-run.mjs` exit 0 on the seven-topic matrix and on the four-pilot matrix; every gated predicate 0, including this round's (`stepToldEarly`, `hindiSpentCold`, `replyCheckin`, `vpcLong`, `vpcBridge`, `reaskRunning`, `workedSeam`, `captionPart`, `whyShortSet`, `cellMissing`, `missAsVerdict`, `whyLeadRunning`, `reaskWhole`, `clarifyAsked`, `wrapAckTwice`); the adversarial probe lost 0 rows. No turn over 75 words on the seven-topic matrix (the four-pilot baseline has 1: a give-up at the greeting that runs the start line, hook, point and card). All 28 picture turns draw the board the plan named (`screen.counts` against `screen.preselected`, compared by hand by main). Turns ending on a comprehension check-in in the steady lessons: c4 7, c5-t01 5, c5-t02 6, c6 4; c5-t03 4, c4-ch01-t02 5, c6-ch07-t01 7 (director30 live, pilots: 4, 5, 4, 4). The rise is by rule: a skill's bridge is said with the verdict and ends on its check-in (so the verdict, point and card turn stays under 65 words), and a verdict said just before a due return ends on a check-in. Re-ask turns by form, 28 lessons: authored re-ask 141, whole card 80, short ask 51. Pending: `repeatedAuthored` 52, `cardNoFit` 1. Compile report: no new hole on the pilots from code; the three staged scripts lack `joints.helpToCard` (the code's forms are said). Method note: the reactive child's lines shift when the walk changes, so check-in counts between dry runs compare rules, not lessons.
md.decisions:
- `dc-r8-reask-two-whole-forms` (2026-11-18, main, part of `dc-r8-director30` item 5): when a card's question has to be said again, the walk alternates the card's authored re-ask and the whole card as written; the short ask stays only after help about the card's own figure; a request to hear the question ("sawaal kya hai?", "phir se bolo") always gets one of the two whole forms. Why: the rotation first built for "no re-ask sentence two turns running" used the card's last clause as a third form, and that clause depends on givens said before it (see `rj-r8-reask-last-clause-alone`). Cost accepted: a whole card is heard again within two turns in 22 places on the four-pilot dry matrix (6 before). **Reverses if** two judges hear the whole card said again as the teacher repeating herself → each card gets a second authored re-ask and the whole card is said again only on request.
- `dc-r8-return-waits-for-followup` (2026-11-18, main): a due return to a parked aside never comes between a remediation and its follow-up card; it is said after that card's verdict, as a turn of its own. Why: in the first dry run of `c6-maths-ch07-t01` she corrected a wrong answer, re-explained, and ended the turn asking about cricket, with the follow-up card two turns later. A teacher finishes what she is correcting. **Reverses if** judges find a parked topic is now returned to so late that the promise reads as forgotten (promises below 3.5 in two topics for that cause) → the return is said before the remediation's turn instead, never inside it.
md.rejected: - `rj-r8-reask-last-clause-alone` (2026-11-18): **tried** saying only the last question clause of a card as a third re-ask form, so that the same re-ask sentence is not heard two turns running (Brain 046 Q5). **What broke:** 21 turns on the seven-topic dry matrix said a last clause alone and 11 of them dangled or needed givens no longer said: after help about a 4-part roti, "Uska ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?" asks about the wrong roti (the card is about the 8-part one); "Ismein kitne hisson mein…", "Inmein se kitne fraction…", "Woh kitna chauda hai?". Every gated predicate read 0 on it; main found it reading the steady lessons. Replaced by `dc-r8-reask-two-whole-forms` and the gated predicate `reaskWhole`.
